crownPassive.name: Galvanism
crownPassive.text: At the start of each round, you gain 1 extra action point for each of your other heroes still alive.

bond.name: Spark of life
bond.text: At upkeep, he and each of your other Gothic heroes heal 2.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Reanimate
actions.text: Return a dead tale-mate to an empty hero slot on 3 health.
